name: Transport Law & Policy
description: Existing rules and regulations relevant to road safety in India; road safety legislation and jurisprudence; history of road safety legislation in India; process and rationale for legislation and policies for road safety; engineers’ role in providing expert input; professional certification and credentialing of engineers – national and international; drafting a policy brief advocating for road safety.
